name: Touch of Y
source:
An unfathomable entity — ancient, powerful, and vast as the universe itself — has turned her gaze upon this world.
She delights in experimenting, shaping, playing, and breaking.
And mortals are nothing more than an endless material for her creativity.
Take on the role of a student of the magical academy and step into this strange, alluring world.
Discover how far unrestrained desires can lead you… and what lies beyond their edge.
Will you be brave and honest enough to face the truth of your own longing?
Will your will be strong enough to walk away from the one even gods whisper about?
And can you bear the weight of her gift…
or will you dissolve forever in the sweet, beckoning shadow she casts over all she touches?
translation:
一位深不可测的存在——古老、强大，如宇宙本身般浩瀚无垠——已将目光投向了这个世界。
她热衷于试验、重塑、拨弄与摧毁。
而凡人不过是供她挥洒创意的无尽素材。
扮演一名魔法学院的学生，踏入这个奇异而迷人的世界吧。
去探寻不受拘束的欲望会将你引向何方……以及欲望的尽头之外究竟藏着什么。
你是否有足够的勇气与坦诚，去直面自己内心深处真正的渴求？
你的意志是否足够坚定，能够从那位连众神都只敢低声谈论的存在身边全身而退？
你又能否承受住她赐予的馈赠之重……
还是终将永远消融在她笼罩万物、甜美而诱人的暗影之中？
